title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
lede: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share for 980 million Class A shares, almost all of them new stock, ahead of Nasdaq trading under the ticker ANT on November 19, 2026.

points: About 956 million shares come from Anthropic and about 23.6 million from existing holders, whose proceeds the company does not receive.
Underwriters hold a 30-day option on up to 147 million more shares.
The SEC declared the registration effective on November 18, and the offering is expected to close on November 20.
Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley distribute the final prospectus.

points.text: The thread splits on whether Anthropic has a moat, with one commenter casting it and OpenAI as the AltaVista of the AI era.
Others argue it has pulled ahead regardless, with Opus 5.5 and Fable unmatched for now and Claude improving steadily as a product.
Commenters work the numbers, noting the offering grew from 825 million shares and estimating roughly $105 billion in cash raised.
One reader points out the S-1 shows about $132 billion in cash against roughly $141 billion raised, at odds with the cash-furnace story.
Valuation unease runs through the thread, with one commenter struck that a 2021 company lists near a $1.5 trillion market cap.
